title: NPC Shops
summary: Hypixel's merchants and what they sell, selling anything for its NPC price, and buying back what you sold.

s.x: Merchants sell what they sell on Hypixel SkyBlock, at Hypixel's prices: the Farm Merchant's 3 Wheat for 7 coins, the Mine Merchant's pickaxes, the Bartender's drinks. All
of Hypixel's shops are in the game's data; the Hub's merchants are open now, and the rest come with their islands.

rows.x: Crops, seeds, Enchanted Bone Meal, the Rookie Hoe
Wool, glass and clay in every colour

s.x: Right-click a merchant to open their shop.
The shop shows its offers in a grid. Hover one to see what it costs: coins, and sometimes items too, each with how many you have. What you can't afford is dimmed.
Every merchant buys anything that has an NPC price. Hover an item in your inventory to see what it sells for, and
Your last 9 sales sit in the
row above your inventory. Click one to buy it back for what you got for it. Buyback is kept until you log out.
